description:
1. Dear Affiliate,

    Welcome to our Affiliate Program! We are thrilled to have you on board as a valued partner in promoting our products/services. This program offers you the opportunity to earn generous commissions by referring customers to us.

    As an affiliate, you play a crucial role in our marketing efforts, and we're here to support you every step of the way. Our program consists of two exciting tier levels: the Iridium Level and the Platinum Level, each offering its own set of benefits and commission rates.

    At the Iridium Level, you will earn a competitive 10% commission on every successful sale you refer. Achieving the Platinum Level comes with even greater rewards, as you will receive an impressive 15% commission. Plus, by reaching the Platinum Level, you can unlock additional bonuses by successfully recruiting new affiliates to join our program.

    We provide you with all the necessary resources to succeed, including personalized affiliate dashboards where you can track your referrals, commissions, and performance metrics. Additionally, you'll have access to a wide range of marketing materials, such as banners, text links, and promotional resources, to enhance your promotional campaigns.

    Our goal is to create a mutually beneficial partnership, and we're committed to providing prompt support whenever you need it. Our dedicated affiliate support team is here to address any questions or concerns you may have along the way.

    To get started, please log in to your affiliate account using the credentials provided to you. Familiarize yourself with the program details, grab your unique affiliate links, and start promoting our products/services to your audience. Remember, the more sales you generate, the higher your earnings potential!

    We're excited to embark on this journey together and look forward to your success as an affiliate. If you have any queries or need assistance, please don't hesitate to reach out to our support team at iridium77inc@gmail.com

    Thank you once again for joining our affiliate program. Let's make this partnership a thriving one!

    Best regards,

    PLATINUM

    Iridium Inc

     
  2.  

  3. Iridium Level:

    • Affiliates at this level will receive a 10% commission on referred sales.
    • To qualify for the Iridium level, affiliates must generate a minimum of 5 sales per month.

  4. Platinum Level:

    • Affiliates at this level will receive a higher commission rate of 15% on referred sales.
    • To qualify for the Platinum level, affiliates must meet two criteria:
      • Generate a minimum of 10 sales per month.
      • Refer at least two new affiliates who successfully join and meet the Iridium level criteria.

Additional Program Details:

  • Affiliates will receive their commission based on the net revenue generated from their referred sales.
  • Commissions will be paid on a monthly basis, within 30 days of the end of each month.
  • Affiliates will have access to a personalized affiliate dashboard to track their referrals, commissions, and performance metrics.
  • Marketing materials such as banners, text links, and promotional resources will be provided to affiliates to assist them in their promotional efforts.
  • Affiliates will have access to a dedicated support team for any questions or assistance they may need.
